en.headline: Joint New Territories South raid arrests 29 over illegal work
en.dek: Officers from several police districts and other departments detained 22 men and seven women in Operation Champion on Thursday, including five mainland women suspected of prostitution.
body: A joint operation targeting illegal workers in New Territories South on Thursday led to the arrest of 29 people, police said.

The Regional Tactical Unit worked with Kwai Tsing, Tsuen Wan, Lantau, Sha Tin and Airport districts and other departments under the codename Champion, raiding several crime blackspots. Those detained were four local men, 13 mainland men, five non-Chinese men, one local woman and six mainland women, aged 22 to 67.

Police said they were held on suspicion of offences including illegal entry, breaching conditions of stay, overstaying, employing people not lawfully employable, and aiding and abetting illegal entry. One man and one woman were wanted persons. Five of the mainland women were also held on suspicion of prostitution while breaching conditions of stay.
All those arrested were being detained for inquiries and would be followed up by police and the relevant departments.

zh.headline: 新界南跨部門反黑工拘29人 五內地女子涉賣淫
zh.dek: 警方聯同相關部門周四進行代號「冠軍」行動，突擊搜查新界南多個罪案黑點，拘捕22男7女。
body: 新界南總區機動部隊聯同葵青、荃灣、大嶼山、沙田及機場警區，以及相關部門，周四進行代號「冠軍」的反非法勞工行動，共拘捕29人。
被捕者包括4名本地男子、13名內地男子、5名非華裔男子、1名本地女子及6名內地女子，年齡介乎22至67歲，分別涉嫌非法入境、違反逗留條件、逾期居留、僱用不可合法受僱的人，以及協助及教唆非法入境。其中一男一女為被通緝人士。
警方表示，當中5名內地女子懷疑進行賣淫活動，同時涉嫌違反逗留條件被捕。
所有被捕人正被扣留調查，稍後由警方及相關部門跟進。
